description: This source file defines an Android activity named DumpActivity which is part of the DumpViewer app. The activity provides a user interface for executing various dump and logcat commands related to Android system diagnostics. It allows users to input commands, view the output in a WebView, perform grep searches, manage command history, and interact with pickers for selecting package or process names. The class includes logic for running commands asynchronously, handling user interactions, and dynamically updating the UI.
